claims.text: The registered temporal response experiment completed with full output/source/frozen/old-file audits, but major gates failed.
Constrained stepwise ADE/FDE increments do not reliably beat native or fresh block control, and acceleration means increase.
Rescued native-inadequate cases and event/timing changes are descriptive and small, not deployed accuracy.
This result does not establish decoder causality, irreducible unpredictability, SOTA, or superiority of AR; no next experiment authorized.
